title: [DEV] Status Line is not showing all information
body:
The Statusline shows the Date of the last reservoir change as well the the age of the Battery, but not it's values. 
On the Action Screen only parts of the value are shown. In Landscape Mode this seems to be working fine.

I would prefer of the value is shown before the age, ao to be able to show the value instead of the age of both.

comments.body: this doesn't have good solution. formating is done by android

Screen look good for me.
Think is is phone or phone settings specific, maybe check phones display setting like resolution en/or font size?

If you select "Skin: Low resolution skin" in the settings, then the superfluous, space-eating labels like "Alter:" and "Abgegeben:" are hidden.
In the past (some years ago), these labels did not exist either. And since the information is actually self-explanatory, we could basically say goodbye to it again. Or @MilosKozak?

But it's a good idea to keep levels and hide ages on low res...

1) The time below COB value is only visible in dev branchs, not in master (I just hide it on my own version).

2) The format of TBR is directly linked to the pump driver and how the pump manage this information:
- for ex with Insight pump, the driver send a % to the pump for standard tbr, and managed the extended tbr by a square bolus. That's why I see in Overview a % when a standard tbr is running, and an absolute rate value when an extended tbr is running.

So if your pump driver send to your pump an absolute rate when a tbr is set, then you will see the absolute rate in overview... (I think it's to be able to check directly with your pump UI if both informations are consistant)
